description_zh: 老版查询数据迁移任务的状态
kebab_example: aliyun dts describe-migration-job-status --migration-job-id dtsxxxxxxxx --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCzxxxxxxxxxx --api-version 2018-08-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeMigrationJobStatus

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data migration task
parameters.name: migration_job_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
